name: minecart-shot-by-rider
comment: WP-4.8 review. The player (id 0, bow in slot 0 and arrows in slot 1, looking straight down) gets into a minecart (id 1) standing on a flat rail at t = 0, then shoots the cart it rides with the bow at t = 8 and t = 12 (use_item on the stone below: no onItemUse, so sendUseItem, ItemBow.onItemRightClick). Each arrow hits the cart (the shooter is skipped while ticksInAir < 5) with attackEntityFrom(this.owner, 4) (EntityArrow.java:163): 40 cart damage, so the second passes 40 and EntityMinecart.attackEntityFrom puts the rider off with riddenByEntity.mountEntity(this) (on top of the cart, Entity.java:992-995), then setEntityDead and the minecart drop (EntityMinecart.java:73-123). The port's arrow passes a copy of its shooter while the rider is in its slot: the cart must dismount it there. entity_state of the player and the cart and rng_state every tick.
